crossRefs.note: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to…
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…

translations.web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
translations.bsb: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
translations.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
translations.asv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.
